title: Combined 'Big Three' stake vs a typical large active manager, avg S&P 500 company

source.name: Index-fund ownership concentration research (approximate, compiled)
source.publisher: Academic/industry research on BlackRock, Vanguard, State Street combined holdings

notes: Approximate; research on 'Big Three' index managers (BlackRock, Vanguard, State Street) commonly cites a combined average stake around one-fifth of the typical S&P 500 company, well above any single active fund manager's typical stake.
